title: Bistek Stir Fry
description: A quick Chinese-inspired stir fry featuring bistek, filipino-style. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Cooking Oil
ingredients.notes: Vegetable or peanut oil work well

instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the bistek and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove the bistek from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of oil and the sliced celery. Cook until the celery is tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the quick filipino seasoning and stir to combine.
Return the bistek to the skillet and stir to combine with the celery and seasoning.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the bistek is cooked through.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
